applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
An aggregate bank can serve several buyers under overlapping instruction intervals. A prior instruction can describe a correct historical allocation yet be inapplicable at a new return settlement. Both effective time and buyer identity are needed to select a current subaccount.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-return-routing`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
